units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 5. Incentives or awards under points 1-3 of part 1 of this Article are granted on the basis of an act of the state body.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 6. Incentives or awards under point 4 of part 1 of this Article are granted on the basis of legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 7. Incentives or awards under points 5 and 6 of part 1 of this Article are granted on the basis of legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 8. The lump-sum incentive provided for by points 1-3 of part 1 of this Article is paid to a civil servant or a citizen dismissed from civil service after nomination for an award or incentive in the amount, according to the procedure and on the conditions approved by the employer’s representative, within the established civil servants’ remuneration fund of the state body.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 9. The lump-sum incentive provided for by point 4 of part 1 of this Article is paid to a civil servant or a citizen dismissed from civil service after nomination for an award or incentive in the amount, according to the procedure and on the conditions established by laws and regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 10. This part was repealed with effect from 14 December 2020 by Law of the City of Moscow of 25 November 2020 No. 26.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 45. Service discipline in the civil service
units.text: Article 45. Service discipline in the civil service
units.label: Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Service discipline in the civil service
units.text: 1. Service discipline in the civil service means civil servants’ mandatory observance of the state body’s service rules and official duties regulations established in accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, this Law, other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, acts of the state body and the service contract.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Service discipline in the civil service
units.text: 2. In accordance with federal laws and other regulatory legal acts, this Law, other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, acts of the state body and the service contract, the employer’s representative must create the conditions necessary for civil servants to observe service discipline.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 45. Service discipline in the civil service
units.text: 3. The state body’s service rules are approved by an act of the state body, taking account of the opinion of that state body’s elected trade union body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 45

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.label: Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 1. For a disciplinary offence, namely culpable non-performance or improper performance by a civil servant of the service duties assigned to them, the employer's representative may impose the following disciplinary sanctions:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 1) an admonition;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 2) a reprimand;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 3) a warning of incomplete suitability for the position;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 4) this point was repealed with effect from 17 July 2015 by Law of the City of Moscow of 24 June 2015 No. 37,;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 5) dismissal from the civil service on the grounds provided for by point 2, subpoints ‘а’–‘г’ of point 3, and points 5 and 6 of part 1 of Article 37 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 2. Only one disciplinary sanction may be imposed for each disciplinary offence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 3. The following sanctions are imposed for a civil servant’s failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’, other federal laws and this Law: 1) an admonition;
units.label: Part 3 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 2) a reprimand;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 3) a warning of incomplete suitability for the position.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 3.1. A civil servant is exempt from liability for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow for the purpose of combating corruption, where such noncompliance and nonfulfilment are recognized as resulting from circumstances beyond the civil servant’s control, in accordance with the procedure provided for by parts 3-6 of Article 13 of the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 46. Disciplinary sanctions and sanctions for failure to comply with restrictions and prohibitions, requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, and failure to fulfil duties established for the purpose of combating corruption (title supplemented with effect from 5 May 2012 by Law of the City of Moscow of 4 April 2012 No. 7,)
units.text: 4. In the cases established by Article 59_2 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, a civil servant shall be dismissed due to loss of trust.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 46

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.label: Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 1. Before imposing a disciplinary sanction, the employer's representative must request a written explanation from the civil servant. If the civil servant refuses to provide such an explanation, a corresponding statement shall be drawn up. A civil servant's refusal to provide a written explanation shall not prevent imposition of a disciplinary sanction.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 2. Before imposing a disciplinary sanction, the employer’s representative conducts an internal service inquiry.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 3. When imposing a disciplinary sanction, the seriousness of the civil servant's disciplinary offence, degree of fault, the circumstances in which it was committed and the civil servant's previous performance of official duties shall be taken into account.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 4. A disciplinary sanction shall be imposed promptly after discovery of the disciplinary offence, but no later than one month from its discovery, excluding periods of the civil servant's temporary incapacity for work, leave, other absence from service for valid reasons, and the time taken by the internal service inquiry.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 5. A disciplinary sanction may not be imposed later than six months after the disciplinary offence was committed, or, following an inspection of financial and economic activities or an audit, later than two years after it was committed. Time spent on criminal proceedings shall not be included in those periods.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 6. A copy of the state body’s act imposing a disciplinary sanction on a civil servant, specifying the grounds for the sanction, is delivered to the civil servant against a signed acknowledgement within five days of issuance of the relevant act.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 7. A civil servant may challenge a disciplinary sanction in writing before the state body’s service disputes commission (hereinafter referred to as the service disputes commission) or a court.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 8. If, within one year of the imposition of a disciplinary sanction provided for by point 1, 2 or 3 of part 1 of Article 46 of this Law or a sanction provided for by point 1, 2 or 3 of part 3 of Article 46 of this Law, a civil servant is not subjected to a new disciplinary sanction, the civil servant is deemed to have no disciplinary sanction.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 9. The employer's representative may lift a civil servant's disciplinary sanction before one year has elapsed from its imposition, on their own initiative, on the civil servant's written application or on a request from the civil servant's immediate supervisor.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 10. This part was repealed with effect from 17 July 2015 by Law of the City of Moscow of 24 June 2015 No. 37.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 47

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.label: Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: 1. The sanctions provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 46 of this Law are imposed by the employer’s representative on the basis of a report on the results of an investigation conducted by the subdivision for prevention of corruption and other offences within the relevant state body’s personnel service, or by an authorized subdivision of the Administration of the President of the Russian Federation in accordance with Article 13.4 of the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’; where the investigation report was referred to the conflict-of-interest resolution commission, its recommendation also serves as a basis. With the civil servant’s consent and provided that the civil servant admits committing the corruption offence, a sanction other than dismissal due to loss of trust may be imposed on the basis of a report by the subdivision for prevention of corruption and other offences within the relevant state body’s personnel service describing the factual circumstances of the corruption offence, and the civil servant’s written explanation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: 2. When imposing the sanctions provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 46 of this Law, account is taken of the nature and seriousness of the civil servant’s corruption offence, the circumstances in which it was committed, the civil servant’s compliance with other restrictions and prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, fulfilment of duties established for the purpose of combating corruption, and previous performance of official duties.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: 3. The sanctions provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 46 of this Law are imposed no later than six months after receipt of information about the civil servant’s corruption offence, excluding periods of temporary incapacity for work, leave or other absence from service for valid reasons, and no later than three years after the offence was committed’, add the following sentence: ‘Time spent on criminal proceedings is not included in those periods.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: 3.1. An admonition may be imposed on a civil servant where their corruption offence is insignificant.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: 4. In an act imposing a sanction on a civil servant for a corruption offence, Article 59_1 or 59_2 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’ is specified as the ground for the sanction.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: 5. A copy of the act imposing a sanction on a civil servant, specifying the corruption offence and the regulatory legal acts whose provisions were breached, or of the act declining to impose such a sanction, stating the reasons, shall be delivered to the civil servant against signature within five days after the relevant act is issued.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: 6. A civil servant may challenge a sanction in writing before the service disputes commission or a court.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: 7. If, within one year of the imposition of a sanction, a civil servant has not been subjected to a disciplinary sanction provided for by point 1, 2 or 3 of part 1 of Article 46 of this Law, or a sanction provided for by point 1, 2 or 3 of part 3 of Article 46 of this Law, the civil servant is deemed to have no sanction.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 47.1. Procedure for imposing sanctions for corruption offences
units.text: 8. Information on the imposition on a civil servant of dismissal due to loss of trust for a corruption offence is entered by the state body in which the civil servant served into the register of persons dismissed due to loss of trust provided for by Article 15 of the Federal Law ‘On Combating Corruption’.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 47.1

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.label: Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 1. An internal service inquiry shall be conducted by decision of the employer's representative or on a civil servant's written application.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 2. An internal service inquiry must establish fully, objectively and comprehensively:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 1) whether the civil servant committed a disciplinary offence;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 2) the civil servant's fault;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 3) the causes and conditions that contributed to the civil servant's disciplinary offence;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 4) the nature and extent of the harm caused by the civil servant as a result of the disciplinary offence;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 5) the circumstances forming the grounds for the civil servant's written application for an internal service inquiry.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 3. The employer's representative who ordered the internal service inquiry shall monitor its timeliness and proper conduct.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 4. The internal service inquiry is entrusted to the state body’s structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters, with the participation of its legal subdivision and elected trade union body and, where necessary, independent specialist experts.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 5. A civil servant with a direct or indirect interest in the outcome of an internal service inquiry may not participate in it. In such cases, they shall submit a written application to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry, requesting release from participation. If this requirement is not met, the results of the internal service inquiry shall be considered invalid.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 6. An internal service inquiry must be completed within no more than 60 calendar days from the decision to conduct it. Its duration may be extended to 90 calendar days by the persons who made that decision. Upon completion, the results shall be reported in a written conclusion to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 7. A civil servant subject to an internal service inquiry may be temporarily suspended from the civil service position held for the duration of the inquiry, with retention of the monetary remuneration for that position during that period. Such temporary suspension shall be effected by the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 8. A civil servant subject to an internal service inquiry shall have the right to:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 1) give oral or written explanations and submit statements, requests and other documents;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 2) appeal to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry against decisions and actions (inaction) of the civil servants conducting it;
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 3) upon completion of the inquiry, examine the written conclusion and other materials relating to its results, unless this conflicts with requirements prohibiting disclosure of information constituting a state secret or another secret protected by federal law.
units.label: Point 3 Part 8 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 9. The written conclusion on the results of the internal service inquiry shall specify:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 1) the facts and circumstances established by the inquiry;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 48

units.locator: Article 48. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 2) a proposal to impose or not to impose a disciplinary sanction on the civil servant.
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 48
